Vaskor, the Stone Maw.traits: A colossal earth elemental with a gaping stone maw, guardian of Floor 20 in the Heart of the Verdant Wild. Its body is composed of living rock and jungle stone.

The Bloom That Hungers.traits: A massive carnivorous plant that serves as the gate guardian of Floor 10 in the Echoing Grotto. Its writhing vines and snapping maw hunger for flesh.

Ashthirst the Hollow.traits: A hollow specter of ash and wind, guardian of Floor 30 in the Fields of Whispering Grasses. It thirsts for the life force of the living.

Gor Vekk, Architect of Ends.traits: An ancient aberration that designs the end of realities, guardian of Floor 90 in the Veiled Expanse. Its very presence warps space and time.

Choralith, Voice Below.traits: An otherworldly entity that speaks in harmonious yet terrifying voices, guardian of Floor 40 in the Sepulcher of Silent Thrones.

Lumen of the Shattered Thread.traits: A radiant being of pure elemental energy, guardian of Floor 50 in the Convergence of the Four Winds. Its form shifts between the four elements.

The Marquis of Silence.traits: The ultimate guardian of Floor 100, a demon lord of unimaginable power who rules through silence and fear. The final challenge of the Abyssal Court.

Threxus, the Iron Spiral.traits: A massive construct of spiraling iron and radiant energy, guardian of Floor 60 in the Halls of Radiant Dawn. Its form constantly shifts in geometric patterns.

Eirfax, the Dusk Crowned.traits: A twilight fey lord crowned with dusk itself, guardian of Floor 70 in the Spiral Nexus of Infinite Echoes. Reality bends around its presence.
